retainedEvidence.retention: Complete original official finite deployment map, full per-chain selector inventories, contract receipts, ABI/source pools and original missing/blocked decisions retained unchanged.
Complete exact-target full mutable interfaces, source-service/explorer lookup grades, ABI/source pools, exclusions and runtime-language prerequisites retained unchanged.

lineage.supersededDecisions: Only the exact multicall root exclusion at these thirteen identities is superseded by a newly implemented finite scope. Other historical exclusions and prerequisites remain. Old direct functions keep their exact IDs, ABIs, scopes and financial input freedom.
lineage.sourceRetention: sourcePool contains complete relevant root/inherited/financial/action-decoding/settlement implementation bodies keyed by exact UTF-8 SHA256. abiPool contains exact complete ABIs from each target-bound installed-facet/interface receipt, deduplicated only after per-target source receipts independently bind the same pool bytes. Every unpooled original body is explicitly hash-referenced by retained exact-target receipt/interface metadata and lineage snapshot SHA256. bytecodePool hashes exact hex text as UTF-8, not policy ABI/semantic identity. Additional verifier/explorer metadata retains exact response/HTML SHA256 and pertinent constructor/immutable/deployed-bytecode material; no crosschain inference or ongoing runtime claim.
lineage.additionalSourcePurpose: Six exact-target Sourcify fields=all responses supplement the earlier body inventories with actual compiler, match, constructor and immutable substitutions. Exact Monad explorer deployment input and deployed bytecode bind its own constructor values; no upgrade from explorer_verified or proxyResolution:null.

identityHashMethod.algorithm: All eighty-five allowed-child ABI hashes were obtained by invoking the actual repository functionAbiHash through node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only on existing catalog functions. These are Keccak-256 of recursively key-sorted JSON [fn.abi], including original names/internalType and declared array order, not SHA256. Seven V4 child executionScopeHash values were obtained through the actual executionScopeHash function on the unchanged existing child scope.
identityHashMethod.childResolution: Exact active verified contract_call IDs and signatures on the same existing chain and target. Pendle admits thirteen existing plain nonpayable functions per target; V4 admits exactly one existing payable modifyLiquidities child with mandatory original scope hash.

pendle.authorization: Every attempted child must pass exact grant/pause/canonical calldata/value checks regardless failure flag; unknown/ungranted/paused/invalid children are policy failures, not optional protocol failures.
